parameters.command:
python3 -c "
import subprocess, json, datetime

# Services
services=[('digital-humans-backend','Backend DH'),('digital-humans-frontend','Frontend DH'),('nginx','Nginx'),('postgresql','PostgreSQL'),('n8n','N8N'),('mcp-system-server','MCP'),('ollama','Ollama')]
ok_svcs=[]; ko_svcs=[]
for svc,label in services:
    r=subprocess.run(['systemctl','is-active',svc],capture_output=True,text=True)
    (ok_svcs if r.stdout.strip()=='active' else ko_svcs).append(label)

# Docker
r=subprocess.run(['docker','ps','--format','{{.Names}}|{{.Status}}'],capture_output=True,text=True)
dockers=[]
for line in r.stdout.strip().split('\n'):
    if '|' in line:
        n,s=line.split('|',1)
        dockers.append(n+' ('+('✅' if 'unhealthy' not in s and 'Exited' not in s else '❌')+')')

# RAM
r=subprocess.run(['free','-h'],capture_output=True,text=True)
mem=r.stdout.split('\n')[1].split()
ram_info=mem[2]+'/'+mem[1]+' utilisé'

# Disque
r=subprocess.run(['df','-h','/'],capture_output=True,text=True)
d=r.stdout.split('\n')[1].split()
disk_info=d[2]+'/'+d[1]+' utilisé ('+d[4]+')'

# Uptime
r=subprocess.run(['uptime','-p'],capture_output=True,text=True)
uptime=r.stdout.strip()

# DH Backend check
try:
    r=subprocess.run(['curl','-s','-o','/dev/null','-w','%{http_code}','http://localhost:8002/docs'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
    dh_api='✅ OK (HTTP '+r.stdout.strip()+')' if r.stdout.strip()=='200' else '⚠️ HTTP '+r.stdout.strip()
except: dh_api='❌ Timeout'

# PostgreSQL stats
try:
    r=subprocess.run(['sudo','-u','postgres','psql','-d','digital_humans_db','-t','-c','SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM execution_entity;'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
    db_stats=r.stdout.strip().replace('\n','  |  ')
except: db_stats='N/A'

# Fail2ban
try:
    r=subprocess.run(['fail2ban-client','status','sshd'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
    banned=[l for l in r.stdout.split('\n') if 'Currently banned' in l]
    f2b=banned[0].strip() if banned else 'OK'
except: f2b='N/A'

result={
    'ok_svcs':ok_svcs,'ko_svcs':ko_svcs,'dockers':dockers,
    'ram':ram_info,'disk':disk_info,'uptime':uptime,
    'dh_api':dh_api,'db_stats':db_stats,'f2b':f2b,
    'date':datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%A %d/%m/%Y'),'time':datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M')
}
print(json.dumps(result))
"
